title: Build 39-dimensional MFCC features
brief: Compute regression deltas, normalize each utterance with cepstral mean and variance normalization so a fixed channel cancels out, and stack the classic 39-dimensional features.
hints: np.pad(c, ((0, 0), (width, width)), mode="edge") repeats the first and last frames, so every shifted slice has T columns.
Accumulate theta * (padded[:, width + theta : width + theta + T] - padded[:, width - theta : width - theta + T]) for theta = 1 to width, then divide by 2 * sum of theta squared.
Normalize along axis 1 with keepdims=True, so the (rows, 1) means and deviations broadcast over time.
The delta-deltas are the deltas of the deltas, not of the MFCCs. Stack c, d, dd with np.vstack before you normalize.
